email.subject1: a co-sell signal play for Clazar
email.body1:
Lalit, saw Clazar closed its $10M Series A and crossed $15M ARR as marketplace co-sell keeps accelerating.

Heading GTM across partnerships and outbound, the hard part is partner-sourced coverage at scale: more co-sell-ready accounts in the cloud ecosystem than the team can activate before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Clazar's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: drafts to your top partner targets
email.body2:
Lalit, quick follow-up for Clazar.

Co-sell motions stall when partner-target outreach is manual and slow, so the best joint accounts sit untouched while reps chase the obvious ones. Speed and personalization at scale are where partner-sourced pipeline actually compounds, and most teams cannot run both at once without adding headcount.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three partner-ecosystem targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body3:
Lalit, last bit of proof for Clazar.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a pipeline gap analysis for your co-sell motion. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lalit, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Building GTM across partnerships and outbound at once is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your partner ecosystem? I will tailor it to Clazar either way.
